header.encoding: One object per case: category, input, now, expected. input is a JSON string holding the exact UTF-16 code units; every unit outside printable ASCII is written as a \uXXXX escape (supplementary characters as escaped surrogate pairs). Inputs containing an unpaired surrogate cannot be a Go or Swift string: for those cases input is null and units holds the UTF-16 code units as integers; they apply only to an entry point that takes UTF-16 units, and for each of them the same input with every unpaired surrogate replaced by U+FFFD (as a Go or Swift string would carry it) is present as a string case of category lone_surrogates_replaced (unless that string already occurs in another category). now and expected are signed 64-bit integers written in full: decode them as integers, never through a double.
